query:
SELECT articleId, COUNT(*) as total, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN reaction='loved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as loved,
  SUM(CASE WHEN reaction='fire' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as fire,
  SUM(CASE WHEN reaction='meh' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as meh,
  SUM(CASE WHEN reaction='thumbsdown' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as td
FROM article_votes 
GROUP BY articleId 
ORDER BY articleId 
LIMIT 10;
